# Moonshine Tiny

Useful Sensors (Moonshine AI) · released 2024-10 · 0.027B params · mit

**score 33.3** ±2.9 · #100 of 117 · from 3 benchmark results across 2 sources

Score within the [Open ASR English short-form WER (March 2026)](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?set=open-asr-wer&score=set) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

                        <a href="https://github.com/handy-computer/transcribe.cpp/blob/c1fee503219ea82dc2e42917150198a31b2ecc2a/catalog/moonshine-tiny.json">FLEURS English test WER</a>         14.1%    25.9   2026-09-15   19% ▇▇

## How to run it

<pre>
version    needs  score
fp32     ~0.63GB   33.3
</pre>

```sh
# fp32
uv run --with transformers --with torch python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition', model='moonshine-ai/moonshine-tiny')('audio.wav')['text'])"
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
